reasoning: On the season so far the Spurs are the stronger team; with home court the Spurs start about 8 points better, in a game of about 224 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Spurs.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Spurs win 75 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 198 and 246 total points.
